title: TMTG plans to launch Truth API on August 1 to provide real-time data from top Truth Social accounts to financial news organizations and trading firms (Sara Fischer/Axios)
summary: Sara Fischer / Axios: TMTG plans to launch Truth API on August 1 to provide real-time data from top Truth Social accounts to financial news organizations and trading firms — Trump Media & Technology Group is launching a backend interface that will allow financial services companies to access real-time Truth Social data …
